Thanks — Samir

Next steps from Redwood:
- We need your replay logs (1–2 hour slice, representative), average doc length distribution, and peak concurrency windows.
- Our benchmarks team will spin up an identical runtime topology (same model family + quantization) and instrument latency, p95/p99, tokens/sec, and cost per 1M tokens.

I’m looping Marissa to coordinate success criteria and CS support during the run.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Auriga renewal — planning for a bakeoff next week

Copying our runbook here. High level plan:
1) Day 0 (today): ingest their replay and sanity-check tokenization, ensure model parity.
2) Day 1: warm-up + baseline with their traffic at 50% speed for validation.
3) Day 2: full 48-hour run with p95/p99, GPU utilization, average KV-cache hit rate, and per-request cost.

Success criteria proposal (suggested):
- p99 latency <= 2.5x of their current baseline AND p95 <= 1.5x (we’ll make these concrete after we see the sample)
- Cost per 1M tokens not more than 12% above their current provider for equivalent quality (we can negotiate band)
- No functional regressions on our output (they should surface 10 representative prompt checks)

Ops ask: we’ll need eng-team@auriga.ai to set up an allowlist for our test nodes and a temporary S3 bucket with replay logs. Also request they enable request-level IDs so we can map telemetry.

Ben — we’ll need a dedicated 2-GPU pool for the run and instrumentation time. Can you confirm resource availability and estimated cost delta?

-Marissa
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding our proposed commercial pathway so Auriga has something tangible for procurement. High level: 3-month committed uplift (2x current baseline) with a performance credit ladder tied to p95/p99 and token-cost targets. If we clear the acceptance gates, we convert the uplift to a 12-month reserved pool at a discounted rate and include one operational playbook run per quarter.

Key commercial bullets for procurement:
- Dedicated reserved pool for the 48-hour bakeoff + 1-week buffer (isolated tenancy).
- Performance credits: 10% credit if we meet p95 target; 25% credit if we meet p95+cost band.
- Short-term retention credit (one-time invoice credit) to offset migration risk.
- Standard SLA: 99.9% infra availability; custom SLO options available for enterprise contract.

Attached: auriga_save_term_sheet_v1.pdf — this is a starting point, legal may redline.

Samir/Elena — happy to jump on a quick call with procurement to walk through terms. We can sign an NDA if you want a deeper telemetry dump.

-ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
